summary: build.review (delta-rereview) of global-agent-skill-sync-v2. All 5 selected domains covered; changedPaths since the accepted prior build review are README.md, README_EN.md, and sync-global.sh; SKILL.md, scripts/test/run.sh, and tests/test_sync_global.sh are digest-identical to the accepted snapshot and were not rescanned in depth. All six scopedFiles sha256 values match on disk; contract rev-0004 digest is unchanged (1c9f2208...) -- the embedded canonicalContract is null this round but the contract-revision evidence pointer is intact with the accepted digest, so specification authority is preserved; .change-state.json (b1952716..., phase=build) and the prior build-review artifact (fad702b6...) digests match. Delta analysis: (1) sync-global.sh now computes SKILL_COUNT while building SKILL_NAMES and uses it in the install_all and verify_all summary lines, correctly reporting "1 + 0" when no sibling xian-* skills exist -- this resolves the prior skill-count info issue; the remainder of the file is byte-identical to the accepted version (preflight all-or-nothing, managed-only uninstall, guard-marker verify, dry-run/--home behavior all unchanged). (2) Both READMEs' hub bullets now say prompts/, references/, hooks/, matching ensure_hub_link targets and resolving the prior documentation naming nit in both languages. git diff --check is clean. Prior-issue re-evaluation: skill-count misreport -- fixed, dropped; README prompt/prompts naming -- fixed, dropped; orphaned managed links for skills removed from the source repo -- still present, re-reported as info; codex-cli-vs-Claude reviewer policy mismatch -- still present, re-reported as info. No new defects were introduced by the delta: the count fix is initialized before use under set -u, alters only display output, and touches no test expectations. Implementation, tests, regression, acceptance, and authority all remain conformant to rev-0004 and AC-001..AC-005 as established in the accepted prior review, with the two documentation/count fixes applied. Accepted for the current phase only; Harness Gate remains the final delivery authority.

issues.title: Orphaned managed links for skills removed from the source repo are not enumerated by status/uninstall
issues.recommendation: Carried over from the prior build review; still present in the current snapshot. SKILL_NAMES is derived from the current repo listing (.codex/skills/xian-*), so a link created by an earlier sync for a skill later removed from the repo is no longer enumerated: uninstall will not remove it and status/verify will not report it. Not an AC violation (drift exposure is documented for tracked skills); recording the managed skill list in the .xian-global-managed marker at install time and having status/uninstall read it would close this lifecycle gap.

issues.title: Bundle reviewer policy pins codex-cli while this change's reviews execute on a Claude reviewer
issues.recommendation: Carried over from prior reviews; bundle policy is unchanged (specReview/buildReview reviewer runtime pinned to codex-cli) while this delta re-review again executed on a Claude runtime. Align the harness reviewer policy with the intended reviewer runtime so future dispatches do not depend on fallback. Configuration alignment note only; not a defect in this build snapshot.

priorIssues.title: Skill-count summary misreports when no sibling xian-* skills exist
priorIssues.recommendation: In install_all and verify_all, `printf '%s\n' $SKILL_NAMES | wc -l` yields 1 even when SKILL_NAMES is empty, so the summary would print "skills: 1 + 1" when no sibling xian-* skills exist in .codex/skills. Display-only edge case (this repo has xian-open/xian-spec); consider guarding the empty case or computing the count while building SKILL_NAMES.

priorIssues.title: README hub bullet says `prompt` but implementation links the `prompts` directory
priorIssues.recommendation: Minor documentation accuracy nit: the hub bullet in README.md and README_EN.md lists the linked artifact as `prompt` (singular), while sync-global.sh actually links the `prompts` directory (ensure_hub_link "$XIAN_COMMIT_HUB/prompts"). Correct the wording to `prompts/` in both READMEs so AC-004's directory description matches the implementation; purely cosmetic, no behavior impact.

priorIssues.title: Orphaned managed links for skills removed from the source repo are not enumerated by status/uninstall
priorIssues.recommendation: SKILL_NAMES is derived from the current repo listing (.codex/skills/xian-*), so a link created by an earlier sync for a skill later removed from the repo is no longer enumerated: uninstall will not remove it and status/verify will not report it. Not an AC violation (drift is documented as exposed via status/verify for tracked skills), but recording the managed skill list in the .xian-global-managed marker at install time and having status/uninstall read it would close this lifecycle gap.

priorIssues.title: Bundle reviewer policy pins codex-cli while this change's reviews execute on a Claude reviewer
priorIssues.recommendation: Carried over from both spec reviews: bundle policy pins specReview/buildReview reviewer runtime to codex-cli, while the change rationale states a Claude-reviewer restart and both spec reviews plus this build review executed on a Claude runtime. Align the harness reviewer policy with the intended runtime so future review dispatches do not depend on fallback. Configuration alignment note only; not a defect in this build snapshot.
